alive.last_commit_message:
fix(cbh): report draft leaks OS login; steps heading + platform alias (#190) (#193)

Fixes #190.

1. Reporter line no longer carries the machine's OS account name. render_report
   now takes the handle from --reporter / CBH_REPORTER, falling back to a
   '(your handle)' placeholder instead of USER/USERNAME, so a public draft can't
   quietly expose a real name or work ID (matches the bundle's evidence-hygiene).
2. '## Steps to reproduce' (and 'Reproduction steps', 'Proof of concept') are now
   recognised as the steps section. The heading regex required the keyword to end
   the line; it now accepts trailing words after a space, while still not matching
   mid-word ('## Stepsister').
3. --platform accepts 'hackerone' as an alias of 'h1'.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
